Simpson's rule integral of an equally-spaced function

Source: R/kernel-smoothing.R
simpson.Rd

Approximates \(\int f(x)\,dx\) from function values value sampled on an equally-spaced grid with step dx, using (composite) Simpson's rule.

Usage

simpson(value, dx = 1)

Arguments

value

Numeric vector of function values on an equally-spaced grid. Simpson's rule needs an odd number of points (an even number of intervals), at least 3; any other length is an error.

dx

Grid spacing; default 1.

Value

A single numeric value, the approximate integral.

References

D'Angelo et al. (2024); see spHawkes-package.

Examples

# The standard normal density integrates to (almost exactly) 1
x <- seq(-4, 4, by = 0.1)
simpson(stats::dnorm(x), dx = 0.1)
#> [1] 0.9999366
